title: Asahina Mafuyu — Cat-Eared Guide〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, you passed the test of courage with flying colors. I'll take your flashlights here.

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler A
rows.Line: That test of courage was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler B
rows.Line: I was worried that it was gonna be really scary, but all the monsters and stuff ended up being really cute...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.
I'll let the monsters know that you thought they were cute.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I promised the scarers that I'd come get them once we finished, so I should find Hinomori and the others.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She should be just over there, so I should probably start with her. The area she covered was—)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That girl... Is she beckoning to me?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(She looks like an elementary schooler.
I don't remember her volunteering today...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And her yukata... It looks so old...)
The yuki-onna girl lost her way.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. Thank you for letting me know. Can you tell me where she is now?

Yeah, my friend said she'd help her...
This way.
I heard a lot of people having fun earlier around the shrine this afternoon. What were you all doing?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We also made shaved ice, which did seem to get everyone excited.
Shaved ice...? I haven't had any in so long.
I had some during a festival at a different shrine a long time ago...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We ran out of shaved ice, but we do still have a few snacks left.
But I didn't help pull weeds or anything...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You told me that my friend was lost.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll set aside enough for you and your friend.

Thanks...
Then, can you leave them behind the shrine office for us?
You seem a little different when you're not with your friends.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you don't need to do what I do, right...?

Oh, even though you noticed us here...
Please don't tell the head priest that you did.
He's a really nice man. He keeps the cemetery nice and clean.
So, I don't want to scare him...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. Then, I promise not to tell him.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori, there you are. Thank goodness I was able to find you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. I got a little lost, but this little girl kindly showed me where to—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The girl I was just with a second ago is gone. Where could she have gone...? I didn't get a chance to thank her...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that should be fine. I promised to give her and her friend some snacks later.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
Then, I'll help you choose what to get.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, we need to find Otori next.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She should be just down that way, so we should be able to find her fairly quickly. Let's go.
